kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
يحتضرا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَضِرَا (yaḥtaḍirā) /jaħ.ta.dˤi.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# يُحْتَضَرَا (yuḥtaḍarā) /juħ.ta.dˤa.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
